name: How much does kitchen cabinet replacement cost in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does kitchen cabinet replacement cost in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen cabinet replacement in Las Vegas varies widely based on several factors, including cabinet material (e.g., laminate, wood, custom), the number of cabinets, hardware choices, and installation complexity. Basic stock cabinets can start from a few thousand dollars for a small kitchen, while custom, high-end options for larger kitchens can easily exceed $15,000. It's best to get a detailed quote from a local contractor for an accurate estimate tailored to your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary significantly based on material, quantity, and complexity. Basic stock cabinets can start at a few thousand dollars, while custom options are much higher. Get a local quote for accuracy.
